title: EARP campaign configuration (earp.v1)
description: Strict, versioned campaign configuration. Unknown keys, absent required keys, and invalid knob values are hard errors. References data by identity; never embeds corpus payloads.

manifest.description: Raw-corpus provenance. Distinct from snapshot; never conflated.

data_root.description: Explicit root for gitignored corpus/gold data. Absence is a typed blocker, never a silent empty gold set.

sha256.description: Full 64-hex content pin (D-6.1). A truncated hash cannot be matched.

corpus_hash.description: Must equal the frozen snapshot hash.

use_default_embedder.description: The only EngineConfig-adjacent setting reaching native open.

projections.description: S7. Declared projections, applied via Engine.configure_projections on the fresh per-scenario database BEFORE ingest. Deliberately excluded from earp.v1: fts_tokenizer / vector_embedder (no supported custom implementations -- a stored identity is not proof of a runtime), drop (a fresh database has nothing to drop), and source segments (deferred). Each exclusion is a catalog UNSUPPORTED entry.

name.description: Non-emptiness is a RESOLVER-collected error: the stdlib walker does not interpret minLength.

vector.description: Requires scenario.engine.use_default_embedder: true. Without an embedder, readiness goes VACUOUSLY ready with zero dense vectors behind it, so the poll witness would lie rather than time out -- resolution is the only honest gate.

readiness_timeout_s.description: Poll bound for vector_dense_readiness. Absent means 30. minimum is 0.1 (not exclusiveMinimum 0): the stdlib walker does not interpret exclusiveMinimum.

call.description: A named SDK call, never a symbolic label.

alpha.description: The engine CLAMPS an out-of-range alpha rather than refusing, so an unbounded value would run as something other than what the sidecar records. Bounded here instead.

pool_n.description: CE-rerank pool size. NOT a result-depth control.

limit.description: The public result limit (0.8.22 Slice 18), mirroring the engine's own window: validate_search_result_limit refuses values outside 1..=100 with a typed error, never a clamp. Absent means 10, the engine default -- config_sha256 covers the raw document, so absence keeps every existing config's hash unmoved. Bounds visible result cardinality on every search verb; @K is measurable exactly when K <= limit.

projection_name.description: The projection to query. Required exactly when call is Engine.search_projected_text, which takes it as a required positional argument -- without it a config resolves cleanly and cannot run.

text.description: The query string actually issued. Without it a config names a call it cannot make.

fixture.description: Path to a human-authored fixture (JSONL of write items). Required for a diagnostic campaign, which has no corpus and no gold.

evidence_recall_k.description: Depth ladder. One rule for every retrieval mode (S6a, the D-5 successor): @K is measurable exactly when K <= the resolved scenario.query.limit (absent means 10; at most 100, the engine's MAX_SEARCH_RESULT_LIMIT). K > 100 is permanently unmeasurable and rejected with metric_not_measurable.

document_metrics.description: ndcg requires graded relevance, which no gold set in this repo carries; requesting it yields not_applicable.

decision_rule.description: Optional. Predeclared before the run (D-4). Absent means metrics may be reported but no better-than claim may be made.

comparison.description: Only a comparison campaign may claim a one-knob causal result; resolved arms must differ only at these paths.

estimated_usd.description: Declared worst case. Summed against experiments/index.jsonl and refused if the cumulative projection exceeds the D-3 authorization.
